title: Dau Pha Thuong Khau Episode 13: The Jia Blade Academy
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic
tone: New location, rival school introduced, competitive challenge, underdog rising

concept.hook: The Jia Blade Academy — the empire's most prestigious combat school — challenged every sect to a student tournament. First place prize: the legendary Skyfire Pill. Xiao Yan signed up alone.
concept.story_arc: Jia Blade Academy challenge arrives → Rival students mocked Xiao Yan's sect → Tournament bracket announced → Xiao Yan vs. the academy's champion student → The match begins
concept.emotion: Challenge → Mockery → Determination → Tournament atmosphere → Match begins → First strike lands

shots.prompt: Wide shot — massive arena stadium, thousands of spectators. Jia Blade Academy students sit in the honored section — their uniforms pristine white. Xiao Yan's sect sits in the common section. The tournament banner reads: 'All-Sect Student Combat Tournament.' Camera: wide — massive arena, Jia Blade Academy in white, Xiao Yan's sect outnumbered, tournament atmosphere. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — massive arena stadium with thousands of spectators, Jia Blade Academy in white section, 6s
shots.narration: The Jia Blade Academy. The empire's most prestigious combat school. Their students wore white — a symbol that no dirt would ever stain them.
shots.sfx: Crowd roar, tournament drums, academy students chanting, Xiao Yan's sect outnumbered, dramatic horn

shots.prompt: Close-up — the academy's champion student, Na Jin, stands in the arena. He wears white martial robes, a jade medallion of rank, and carries a ceremonial jia blade. His presence radiates arrogance. 'Who wants to be first?' His blade FANS OUT with wind qi. Camera: close-up — Na Jin's arrogant face, jade medallion, wind blade fanning out, challenger stance. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Na Jin's arrogant face, wind qi blade fanning out, champion challenger stance, 6s
shots.narration: Na Jin. Five consecutive tournament championships. His wind blade had broken seventeen opponents in one strike.
shots.sfx: Wind blade whooshing, wind qi crackling, crowd gasping, arrogant laughter, blade activation sound

shots.prompt: Medium shot — the announcer points at Xiao Yan. 'And from the废物 sect... Xiao Yan!' Laughter erupts from the Jia Blade students. They throw garbage at him as he walks to the arena. Xiao Yan's expression is perfectly calm. Camera: medium — announcer pointing, garbage thrown at walking Xiao Yan, his perfect calm, academy students laughing. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — announcer pointing at Xiao Yan, garbage thrown at him walking to arena, his perfect calm, 6s
shots.narration: They threw garbage at him. He walked through it. Because he knew — in five minutes — they would all be silent.
shots.sfx: Garbage thrown, crowd laughing, his footsteps calm and measured, ominous music building, wind in arena

shots.prompt: Close-up — Xiao Yan steps into the arena. Na Jin sneers. 'Walk away,废物. You won't even be able to draw your blade.' Xiao Yan raises one finger. Na Jin frowns. Xiao Yan: 'One strike. That's all I need.' Na Jin's eyes narrow. Camera: close-up — Xiao Yan's raised finger, Na Jin's confused sneer, the one-finger challenge, arena tension building. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Xiao Yan's one-finger challenge, Na Jin's confused sneer, arena tension peak, 6s
shots.narration: 'One strike.' The crowd fell silent. Na Jin — undefeated champion — raised his wind blade. This was going to be over in seconds.
shots.sfx: Silence falling, wind blade humming, Na Jin's blade raising, tension drumbeat, crowd holding breath

shots.prompt: Slow-motion wide shot — Na Jin's wind blade SLASHES toward Xiao Yan. Blue flame IGNITES on Xiao Yan's single raised finger. One point of blue fire against the wind blade. The two techniques COLLIDE. Camera: slow-motion wide — wind blade vs. single blue flame point, collision moment, arena freeze-frame. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Slow-motion wide — Na Jin's wind blade clashing with Xiao Yan's single blue flame finger, collision freeze-frame, 6s
shots.narration: One finger. One flame. The collision — silenced everyone in the arena.
shots.sfx: Techniques colliding, explosive impact, crowd gasp, blue flame roaring, impact echo in arena

audio.narration: The Jia Blade Academy. The empire's most prestigious combat school. Their students wore white — a symbol that no dirt would ever stain them. Na Jin. Because he knew — in five minutes — they would all be silent. 'One strike.' The crowd fell silent. Na Jin — undefeated champion — raised his wind blade. This was going to be over in seconds. One finger. One flame. The collision — silenced everyone in the arena.
